subject.title: Stale .jsonl.lock + stuck typing indicator after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError on parallel subagent fan-out

question: Which path should own the remaining EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError fan-out work: keep this issue as the umbrella while focused PRs land, split it into narrower canonicals, or add an explicit serialization/workaround surface?
rationale: The report spans session locks, subagent delivery persistence, Telegram typing cleanup, and possible serialization behavior, and current open PRs cover only slices of that surface.

options.title: Sequence Focused Fixes Here
